title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 5, 2026, relative to Street Takeovers, Street Racing,
text:
[4. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 5, 2026, relative to Street Takeovers, Street Racing,
  and the Department’s Street Racing Task Force (City Council File No. 26-1150), as set forth.
  [BPC #26-360]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s Report and TRANSMIT to the City Council.
summary: The Police Commission will approve a Police Department report on street takeovers and street racing, including the Street Racing Task Force, and send it to City Council.

details.action: report approval and transmittal to City Council
